spec.title: Wayfarer Shoemakers Stop
spec.conceptPrompt: A travelling shoemaker opens a roadside fitting stop: cloth boots, brass lasts and display racks unfold as fitting buckles accumulate during free spins, with racks sharing their central reel.
spec.summary: 고정 릴의 라인 방식. 프리스핀은 가운데 릴을 공유하는 여러 신발 진열대에서 동시에 진행한다. 피팅 버클이 누적되면 다음 스핀부터 진열대가 더 펼쳐진다. Star Atlas 계열의 별개 테마 초안.

themeBible.theme: A fictional travelling shoemaker fits walking shoes on linked display racks at a roadside stop.
themeBible.lighting: Clear teal ambient light, coral highlights and violet depth; add a colour and musical layer at each actual progression, with medium-scale bonus entry and final reward emphasis.
themeBible.materials: Woven travel cloth, brushed brass fittings and folded paper route maps, with tactile subject-specific surfaces.
forbidden: Real brands, logos, trademarks or branded real-world place names
Real people, identifiable likenesses or personal information
Existing game or film characters, licensed characters or other borrowed IP
Actual gambling venues or real-world gambling-location imagery
Safety claims for low tiers, guaranteed profits or return promises
Implying large caps or top rewards occur frequently
Using added waiting time to communicate volatility
Changing RNG, probabilities, prices, feature eligibility, decision policies or representative event order through art
Letters or numbers baked into non-card symbol art; keep value overlays separate
Stars, celestial charts, astrolabes, observatory domes, telescopes and actual footwear brands
themeBible.styleKeywords: original fictional travel illustration, teal coral violet, cloth brass paper maps, layered actual progression, medium-scale bonus accents, clean silhouette

assetSlots.label: Cabinet (3D)
assetSlots.prompt: A teal cloth fitting pavilion opens beside a fictional walking trail, with coral shoes on brass racks and violet cloth-backed paper itineraries behind the reels. Do not carve, paint or write any title, words or letters anywhere on the cabinet: the game logo is overlaid on the top marquee. No blank nameplates, empty plaques, paper scrolls or label panels anywhere — fill those areas with theme ornament instead. Side props and figures must be finely modelled with detailed theme materials (no blocky low-poly lumps or plain mannequin shapes). The reel window is one open dark recess with a plain dark teal backing — no paper strips, sheets or panels behind the reels (the free spins show several small reel boards inside this window).

vfxBriefs.prompt: 기대 연출(Anticipation, 0928): 스캐터를 기다리는 그 릴 둘레에만, 이 게임의 테마 색(주 #258F94, 밝은 #AFDEDA)으로 빛나는 얇은 빛 테두리와 천 탭이 달린 황동 신발 버클 형태의 고유 테마 3D 오브젝트(테마 vfx-model 메시) 입자가 릴을 따라 아래에서 위로 천천히 흐르고, 릴이 멈출 때까지 이어진다. 긴장감은 빛의 맥동과 입자 속도로 만들고 화면 전체를 덮지 않는다. 카메라는 고정하며, 정지 뒤 잔광이나 추가 대기시간을 붙이지 않는다. 청록 테두리 위 코랄·보라 입자가 실제 릴 정지 진행에 맞춰 한 층씩 더해지되, 기대 연출 자체가 보상이나 다음 단계 도달을 암시하지 않게 절제한다.
vfxBriefs.negative: yellow / gold as the main colour, default_coin / default_star / default_shard meshes, crowns or chests, camera moves, full-screen flashes
